main_body: palm tree (crown of fronds above segmented trunk)
top_band: upper green crown of palm fronds (rows 1-11, brightest yellow-green at rows 5-7)
evidence: Crown of palm fronds occupies rows 0-25, with the upper canopy dome spanning rows 1-11 and hanging fronds overlapping the trunk; the segmented trunk extends down from row 12 to 40 with a cast shadow under the crown at rows 12-13.

style.evidence: Uses a 5-step green ramp on the fronds and 4-5 browns on the segmented trunk with dark green and dark brown outlines, though the base of the trunk is cut off cleanly and the frond strips are somewhat simpler and more banded than the richly clustered Beodeul foliage.
